description: This file defines the JobCategory entity class for the OrangeHRM system, representing a job category with id and name properties mapped to a database table using Doctrine ORM.

classes.name: JobCategory
classes.description: Entity class representing a job category with properties for id and name, mapped to the 'ohrm_job_category' database table.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier for the job category.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the identifier for the job category.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the job category.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the job category.
